name: How does kitchen pathway widening differ from a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does kitchen pathway widening differ from a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen pathway widening focuses specifically on altering the layout and clear floor space to improve circulation. While it often involves some demolition and reconstruction, its primary goal is enhancing traffic flow. A full kitchen remodel, in contrast, is a more comprehensive project that typically involves replacing all cabinets, countertops, appliances, and often reconfiguring the entire kitchen's aesthetics and functionality, sometimes including pathway widening as part of the larger scope. Pathway widening can be a standalone project or part of a remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pathway widening focuses on improving kitchen circulation and space, whereas a full remodel replaces all elements and reconfigures the entire kitchen, which may include widening.
